import { describe, test } from 'node:test';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const canSudo = spawnSync('sudo', ['-n', 'true']).status === 0;
describe('the engine unit', { skip: !canSudo && 'needs passwordless sudo' }, () => {
  test('restarts after a crash', () => {
    const r = spawnSync('sudo', ['-n', 'systemctl', 'restart', 'worklane.service'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(r.stderr);
  });
});
